title: China's share of Japan's imports of nuclear components fell from 40% to 14%
subtitle: Share of Japan's imports that come from China: 2024 vs the latest 12 months to Aug 2026; the steps that moved most
notes: Steps with at least $200m of imports in both periods and a move of 8 points or more. Latest 12 months of the country's own monthly customs reports to UN Comtrade (to Aug 2026). China excludes Hong Kong and Macao.
